mainEntity.name: How does GEO differ from traditional SEO for accounting firms?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on ranking high on standard search engine results pages, GEO for accounting firms specifically targets AI-driven search and discovery. Traditional SEO might emphasize keywords for web pages, but GEO considers how AI models understand context, intent, and generate responses. This involves optimizing for conversational queries, semantic search, and ensuring your firm's information is structured in a way that AI can easily interpret and present to users. GEO adapts to the increasing reliance on AI assistants and generative search experiences for finding services.
acceptedAnswer.description: GEO for accounting firms specifically targets AI-driven search and discovery, optimizing for conversational queries and AI interpretation, unlike traditional SEO's focus on standard search engine ranking.
